namespace = cosmo_pleasure_events

# Palembang - Return of Piracy
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_pleasure_events.8
	title = "cosmo_pleasure_events.8.t"
	picture = cosmogfx_ASIAN_PIRATE_GENERAL_8_eventPicture
	desc = "cosmo_pleasure_events.8.d"
	is_triggered_only = yes


	trigger = {
		ai = no
	}


	option = {
		name = "cosmo_pleasure_events.8.a"
		PLB = {
		change_primary_culture = pirate_asian
		add_accepted_culture = sumatran	
		add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom
		define_ruler = {
			force_republican_names = yes
			culture = wu
		}
		swap_non_generic_missions = yes
		}
		622 = {
			change_culture = pirate_asian
			add_building = port_of_pleasure
				add_province_modifier = { 
					name = cosmo_pirates_allowed
					desc = cosmo_pirates_allowed_DESC
					duration = -1  
				}
		}
		2678 = {
			change_culture = pirate_asian
			add_building = port_of_pleasure
				add_province_modifier = { 
					name = cosmo_pirates_allowed
					desc = cosmo_pirates_allowed_DESC
					duration = -1  
				}
		}		
	}

	option = {
		name = "cosmo_pleasure_events.8.b"
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_country_flag = no_piracy_cosmo
				}
			}
			PLB = {
				add_stability = 1
			}
			set_country_flag = no_piracy_cosmo			
		}
	}
}

#privateer port of pleasure launch
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_pleasure_events.11
	title = cosmo_pleasure_events.11.t
	desc = cosmo_pleasure_events.11.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PORT_ROYAL_INN_eventPicture
	goto = popprovince


	trigger = {
		ai = no
		OR = {
			any_owned_province = {
				any_privateering_country = {
					capital_scope = {
						continent = europe
					}
				}
				has_building = port_of_pleasure
				privateer_power = {
					#country = PREV
					share = 1
				}
			}
			any_subject_country = {
			any_owned_province = {
				any_privateering_country = {
					capital_scope = {
						continent = europe
					}
				}				
				has_building = port_of_pleasure
				privateer_power = {
					#country = PREV
					share = 1
				}
			}				
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = cosmo_pirates_at_pop
		}		
	}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
	days = 1
	}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				has_building = port_of_pleasure
				any_privateering_country = {
					capital_scope = {
						continent = europe
					}
				}				
				privateer_power = {
					#country = PREV
					share = 1
				}				
			}
			save_event_target_as = popprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				has_building = port_of_pleasure
				any_privateering_country = {
					capital_scope = {
						continent = europe
					}
				}								
				privateer_power = {
					#country = PREV
					share = 1
				}
			OR = {
				province_id = 487 #Port Royal 
				province_id = 482 #New Providence
				province_id = 489 # Tortuga
				province_id = 4024 #Libertatia
				province_id = 4745 #Rugen
		#		province_id = 1563 #Pattani
				province_id = 622 #Palembang
			}
			}
			save_event_target_as = popprovince
		}		
		set_country_flag = cosmo_pirates_at_pop
		}
	}		
		
	
	option = { #open port
		name = cosmo_pleasure_events.11.12	
		set_country_flag = cosmo_pirates_built
		event_target:popprovince = {
				add_unrest = 2			
				add_province_modifier = { 
					name = cosmo_pirates_allowed
					desc = cosmo_pirates_allowed_DESC
					duration = -1  
				}
			every_trade_node_member_country = {
				limit = {
					navy_size = 1
					NOT = {
						is_subject_of = ROOT
						alliance_with = ROOT
						has_opinion = {
							who = ROOT
							value = 100
						}						
					}
				}
				add_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_pirates_allowed_opinion
				}				
			}				 
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			add_country_modifier = {
					name = cosmo_pirates_atpop
					duration = 1825  
					hidden = yes				
			}
		}				
		#negative opinion every 5 years with modifier timed event
		#gives -50 opinion for every port of pleasure
		#applied to every country that is being privateered
		#opinion called Gives Harbour to Pirates
		#pirate modifier
			#small amount of trade power
			#also gives some unrest because of unruly pirates
			#also give claim on province to those pirated 
		#unlocks Pirate affair
		#pirate affair gives random event based on conditions in provinces with pirate
	}
	option = { #close port
		name = cosmo_pleasure_events.11.13	
		add_mercantilism = 2 
		#negative opinion every 5 years with modifier timed event
		#gives -50 opinion for every port of pleasure
		#applied to every country that is being privateered
		#opinion called Gives Harbour to Pirates
		#pirate modifier
			#small amount of trade power
			#also gives some unrest because of unruly pirates
			#also give claim on province to those pirated 
		#unlocks Pirate affair
		#pirate affair gives random event based on conditions in provinces with pirate
	}										
}

#privateer port of pleasure repeater
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_pleasure_events.12
	title = cosmo_pleasure_events.12.t
	desc = cosmo_pleasure_events.12.d
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {
				culture_group = japanese_g				
		}
			}	
	picture = COURT_eventPicture
	}	
	picture = {
	trigger = {
				culture_group = japanese_g				
			}	
	picture = cosmogfx_OOKU_GENERAL_8_eventPicture
	}
	goto = popprovince

	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		OR = {
			any_owned_province = {
				has_province_modifier = cosmo_pirates_allowed
				has_building = port_of_pleasure
			}
			any_subject_country = {
			any_owned_province = {
				has_province_modifier = cosmo_pirates_allowed
				has_building = port_of_pleasure
			}				
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_country_modifier = cosmo_pirates_atpop
		}		
	}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
	days = 30
	}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		add_country_modifier = {
				name = cosmo_pirates_atpop
				duration = 1825  
				hidden = yes				
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
			has_province_modifier = cosmo_pirates_allowed	
			OR = {
				province_id = 487 #Port Royal 
				province_id = 482 #New Providence
				province_id = 489 # Tortuga
				province_id = 4024 #Libertatia
				province_id = 4745 #Rugen
			#	province_id = 1563 #Pattani
				province_id = 622 #Palembang
			}
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			NOT = {
				has_province_flag = had_pirate_spawn
				owner = {
					OR = {
					has_reform = pirate_republic_reform 
					#has_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom
			has_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom
					#has_government_attribute = is_cosmo_pirate_kingdom 
					}
				}
			}			
			}
			save_event_target_as = popprovince
		}				
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_province = {
				has_province_modifier = cosmo_pirates_allowed	
				OR = {
					province_id = 487 #Port Royal 
					province_id = 482 #New Providence
					province_id = 489 # Tortuga
					province_id = 4024 #Libertatia
					province_id = 4745 #Rugen
				#	province_id = 1563 #Pattani
					province_id = 622 #Palembang					
				}
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				NOT = {
					has_province_flag = had_pirate_spawn
					owner = {
						OR = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform 
						#has_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom
			has_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom
					#has_government_attribute = is_cosmo_pirate_kingdom 
						}
					}
				}				
				}				
			}
			set_country_flag = spawning_pirate_cosmo
		}		
		}
	}		
		
	
	option = { #open port
		name = cosmo_pleasure_events.12.12	
		every_province = {
			limit = {
				has_province_modifier = cosmo_pirates_allowed
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			}
			every_trade_node_member_country = {
				limit = {
					navy_size = 1
					NOT = {
						is_subject_of = ROOT
						alliance_with = ROOT
						has_opinion = {
							who = ROOT
							value = 100
						}						
					}
				}
				add_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_pirates_allowed_opinion
				}				
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = spawning_pirate_cosmo
			}
			country_event = { 
			id = cosmo_pleasure_events.13
			}			
		}				
	}
	after = {
		clr_country_flag = spawning_pirate_libertatia
		clr_country_flag = spawning_pirate_cosmo
	}										
}

# train nothing happens
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_pleasure_events.8023
	title = cosmo_pleasure_events.8023.t
	desc = cosmo_pleasure_events.8023.d
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoBrothelTrainingIndentured	
			value = 1
			}
	}
	}	
		picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_1A_eventPictures
		}
		picture = {
		trigger = {
		NOT = {	
		check_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingIndentured
				value = 21
				}
	}
	}	
		picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_1B_eventPictures
		}	
		picture = {
		trigger = {
		NOT = {	
		check_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingIndentured
				value = 41
				}
	}
	}	
		picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_1C_eventPictures
		}
		picture = {
		trigger = {
		NOT = {	
		check_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingIndentured
				value = 61
				}
	}
	}	
		picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_1D_eventPictures
		}
		picture = {
		trigger = {
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingIndentured
				value = 81
				}
	}
	}	
	picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_1E_eventPictures
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {	
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoBrothelTrainingIndentured
			value = 101
			}
	}	
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_1F_eventPictures
	}	
	goto = portofpleasure

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
	ai = no	
	}
	
	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
			random_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			
				has_province_modifier = indentured_servant_runaway_prostitutes
			}
				save_event_target_as = portofpleasure
			}
		}
		}	
	

	option = {			# We will exploit this!
		name = cosmo_pleasure_events.8023.a			
		hidden_effect = {
			change_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingIndentured
				value = 25
				}		
			}
	}	
}

			}
}
}

	}

country_event = {
	id = cosmo_pleasure_events.21
	title = cosmo_pleasure_events.21.t
	desc = cosmo_pleasure_events.21.d
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPleasureCounter	
			value = 1
			}
		}
			}

	}

	trigger = {
	NOT = {

			value = 61
			}
		}
		}	
	picture = cosmogfx_PORT_OF_PLEASURE_MENU_4_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {
			OR = {
				culture_group = germanic		
				culture_group = scandinavian		
				culture_group = british		
				culture_group = gaelic
				culture_group = latin
				culture_group = iberian		
				culture_group = french	
				culture_group = carpathian		
				culture_group = south_slavic		
				culture_group = west_slavic			
				culture_group = east_slavic		
				culture_group = baltic		
				culture_group = byzantine		
				culture_group = caucasian
			}		
		NOT = {
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPleasureCounter
			value = 81
			}
		}
	}	
	picture = cosmogfx_PORT_OF_PLEASURE_MENU_5_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {	
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPleasureCounter
			value = 101
			}
	}	
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_PORT_OF_PLEASURE_MENU_6_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {	
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPleasureCounter
			value = 121
			}
	}	
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_PORT_OF_PLEASURE_MENU_7_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {	
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPleasureCounter
			value = 141
			}
	}	
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_PORT_OF_PLEASURE_MENU_8_eventPicture
	}
	goto = pleasureprovince
	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		always = no
		any_owned_province = {
		is_owned_by_trade_company = yes
		trade_company_size = 10
		has_building = port_of_pleasure
		OR = {
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = africa_superregion 
			}		
	NOT = {
		has_province_modifier = west_african_slave_prostitutes
		has_province_modifier = west_african_prostitutes
		}		
		}
	}
	
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 18
	}
	
	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		random_province = {
			limit = {
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
		OR = {
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = africa_superregion
				superregion = southern_africa_superregion 
			}
	NOT = {
		has_province_modifier = west_african_slave_prostitutes
		has_province_modifier = west_african_prostitutes
		}			
			has_building = port_of_pleasure
			is_owned_by_trade_company = yes
			trade_company_size = 10		
			}
			save_event_target_as = pleasureprovince
			}
		}
	}		
	
	option = {
		name = cosmo_pleasure_events.21.a
		event_target:pleasureprovince = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				superregion = near_east_superregion
			}
		add_province_modifier = {
			name = west_african_slave_prostitutes
			duration = 1440  
			desc = west_african_slave_prostitutes_DESC

		}
		}		
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
				superregion = africa_superregion 
				superregion = southern_africa_superregion 
				}
			}
		add_province_modifier = {
			name = west_african_slave_prostitutes
			duration = 1440  
			desc = west_african_slave_prostitutes_DESC

		}
		}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
				which = cosmoPleasureCounter
				value = 20
				}
		}
	}
}

			has_building = port_of_pleasure
		}
		}
		clr_province_flag = no_port_of_pleasure_here	
		}			
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				area = top_end_area
			}
		every_province = {
		limit = {
			area = top_end_area
		NOT = { 
			has_building = port_of_pleasure
		}
		}
		clr_province_flag = no_port_of_pleasure_here	
		}			
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				area = top_end_area
			}
		every_province = {
		limit = {
			area = south_sumatra_area
		NOT = { 
			has_building = port_of_pleasure
		}
		}
		clr_province_flag = no_port_of_pleasure_here	
		}			
		}				
	}	
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
				which = cosmoPleasureCounter
				value = 20
				}
		}
	}
	after = {
		every_province = {
			limit = {
				has_province_flag = destroy_port_of_pleasure
			}
			clr_province_flag = destroy_port_of_pleasure
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = cosmo_pleasure_events.10123
	title = cosmo_pleasure_events.10123.t
	desc = cosmo_pleasure_events.10123.d
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoBrothelTrainingWestAfrican	
			value = 1
			}
	}
	}	
		picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_WEST_AFRICA_1A_eventPictures
		}
		picture = {
		trigger = {
		NOT = {	
		check_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingWestAfrican
				value = 21
				}
	}
	}	
		picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_WEST_AFRICA_1B_eventPictures
		}	
		picture = {
		trigger = {
		NOT = {	
		check_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingWestAfrican
				value = 41
				}
	}
	}	
		picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_WEST_AFRICA_1C_eventPictures
		}
		picture = {
		trigger = {
		NOT = {	
		check_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingWestAfrican
				value = 61
				}
	}
	}	
		picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_WEST_AFRICA_1D_eventPictures
		}
		picture = {
		trigger = {
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingWestAfrican
				value = 81
				}
	}
}	
	picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_WEST_AFRICA_1E_eventPictures
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {	
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoBrothelTrainingWestAfrican
			value = 101
			}
	}	
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_TRAINING_WEST_AFRICA_1F_eventPictures
	}	
	goto = portofpleasure

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
	ai = no	
	}
	
	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
			random_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			
				has_province_modifier = central_african_slave_prostitutes
			}
				save_event_target_as = portofpleasure
			}
		}
		}	
	

	option = {			# We will exploit this!
		name = cosmo_pleasure_events.10123.a			
		hidden_effect = {
			change_variable = {
				which = cosmoBrothelTrainingWestAfrican
				value = 25
				}		
			}
	}	
}
